catalog.name: steward
catalog.job: Durable coordination, changing support, independent acceptance, receipt-based completion
catalog.why_separate: A real state machine and durable work authority. Explicitly protected by Daniel.

catalog.name: engineering
catalog.job: Verified code changes, architecture investigations, implementable designs, dependency assessment
catalog.why_separate: One owner can finish these closely related software jobs from repository context. Flat branch selection preserves read-only design.

catalog.name: review
catalog.job: Independent assessment of code, plans, understanding, designs, or work reports
catalog.why_separate: A distinct request and role, especially Steward acceptance; code-only review would lose a protected capability.

catalog.name: debugging
catalog.job: Causal investigation and verified correction when requested
catalog.why_separate: Owns hypothesis/probe iteration to an answer, rather than returning a causal assessment for the same agent to operationalize.

catalog.name: interface-design
catalog.job: Usable interfaces and question-driven interaction prototypes
catalog.why_separate: Product experience and visual/interaction craft need their own job and verification.

catalog.name: augment-design
catalog.job: Augment identity, voice, assets, and surface constraints
catalog.why_separate: Private authoritative brand knowledge applies beyond product UI.

catalog.name: github
catalog.job: Complete current GitHub facts and authorized operation receipts
catalog.why_separate: Real helpers and platform gaps cannot be replaced by generic review instructions.

catalog.name: grafana
catalog.why_separate: Live query/discovery mechanics and population semantics are an independent acquisition capability.

catalog.name: augment-workflows
catalog.job: Live Augment graph authoring, operation, review, and diagnosis
catalog.why_separate: Product lifecycle authority, canonical resources, graph contracts, and outcome observations.

catalog.name: ai-engineering
catalog.job: Bounded AI inference and faithful derived work products
catalog.why_separate: Crosses semantic quality, source fidelity, typed consumer behavior, and publication/delivery boundaries.

catalog.name: evaluation
catalog.why_separate: A complete independent job, applicable to router quality and instruction usefulness as well as implementation.

catalog.name: writing
catalog.job: Faithful drafting, editing, reviewer-facing explanations, and voice
catalog.why_separate: Owns authorship and reader comprehension; supplied text editing differs from new claims.

catalog.name: writing-for-agents
catalog.job: Executable agent instructions and dependable packaging
catalog.why_separate: Demands, triggers, context reachability, and behavioral tests differ from prose voice.

catalog.name: creative-ideation
catalog.job: Specific ideas, alternatives, creative exercises, selection and deepening
catalog.why_separate: The 22 actual methods teach useful operations and protect creative breadth.

catalog.name: diagram-design
catalog.job: Standalone, imported, exportable, or source-sensitive visual artifacts
catalog.why_separate: Specialist semantics, formats, recipes, and export fidelity add value beyond managed inline visualization.

cuts.cut: The shared core/operational-caller composition protocol and generic status envelopes
cuts.retain: The actual method, factual gaps, meaningful uncertainty, and ordinary authority boundaries. Steward's actual runtime event/review contracts remain exact.
cuts.loss: Supplied-only conceptual assessment interfaces become less directly selectable; read-only judgment remains an available job.

cuts.retain: 15 complete-job interfaces plus selectively read private methods. Architecture/spec are flat engineering jobs; evaluation remains independent.
cuts.loss: 26 old public skill names disappear, five new names are introduced, and ten names remain. Their retained jobs must be discoverable through natural prompts. Branch instructions cannot enforce the old architecture/spec per-skill metadata policy; actual host routing must be tested.

cuts.cut: Global engineering checklist, public-JSDoc accounting, universal failure-algebra mandate and categorical mocking/spy bans
cuts.retain: Precise values, expected failures, owned effects, TypeScript soundness, independent oracles and actual-boundary evidence where applicable.
cuts.loss: These are substantive relaxed prescriptions, not mere repackaging. Broad consistency law is traded for task/repository-grounded judgment.

cuts.cut: Fixed hypothesis counts and local-red/minimization prerequisites
cuts.retain: Strong symptom signal, reproduction adequacy, falsifiable alternatives and discriminating observations.
cuts.loss: A universal laboratory-shaped process no longer gates production-only diagnosis.

cuts.cut: Automatic spec TDD, prototype no-tests rule, and mandatory three radical UI variants
cuts.retain: Selected vertical-slice TDD, necessary tests, meaningful range for open taste, and cheapest credible question-driven prototype.
cuts.loss: A fixed process/variant count no longer guarantees breadth or discipline; observed evidence must establish adequacy.

cuts.cut: Uncalibrated prose score, detector thresholds, universal novelty/proper-noun quotas, and mandatory grounded derivatives for fiction
cuts.retain: Actual voice examples, conservative meaning protection, concrete artistic method and specificity.
cuts.loss: Numeric ceremony and forced practicality disappear; no claim that all odd language is AI language.

cuts.cut: Universal diagram grid/shadow/corner law and NatStat-only product kits
cuts.retain: All useful semantic forms and import/export methods; brand-specific laws apply only to that brand. Unknown remains distinct from denied/false/zero.
cuts.loss: Product-specific NatStat aesthetics/context archived outside active references after reusable semantics are extracted.

cuts.cut: Historical maintenance ledgers and old audit narratives from the active learning path
cuts.retain: Recoverable repository history, indispensable lessons and examples, old Steward record intelligibility.
cuts.loss: Agents will no longer receive the full history of how each instruction was written unless that history matters to the task.

cuts.cut: TypeSafe as a default standalone AI proposition
cuts.retain: Vendor knowledge and license, live docs when selected, typed inference and calibrated probability principles independent of vendor.
cuts.loss: Automatic vendor promotion/discovery is removed; the vendor is chosen for the actual job.

behavioral_acceptance.status: Proposed; no empirical baseline-vs-candidate model evaluation has yet run.
behavioral_acceptance.routing: Exercise positive, negative, collision and multi-skill tasks using actual target-host catalog metadata. Inspect selection and read-only boundaries.
behavioral_acceptance.task_quality: Compare original and candidate instructions on fresh historical/regression and held-out realistic cases with independent judgments. Measure usable outcome, scope expansion, fidelity, skipped obligations, clarification burden, context/time cost and failure strata.
behavioral_acceptance.runtime: Run unchanged state-machine and replay tests; compare real end-to-end actor reconciliation, owner correction, support withdrawal, independent acceptance and receipt reopening.
behavioral_acceptance.helpers: Add meaningful regressions for observed pagination/audit/export errors; inspect actual rendered visuals and applied fonts.
behavioral_acceptance.distribution: Package and dry-run host-specific projections; check links/assets/metadata/byte limits without pushing. Preserve history and rollback. Do not install until this design is selected for implementation.
behavioral_acceptance.decision: Adopt only if protected behavior and required quality survive and selection/process burden falls. Split engineering design or change a boundary if observed routing failures justify it.
